title: polemonium carneum subsp. luteum
intro: Polemonium carneum subsp. luteum, commonly known as Yellow Jacob's Ladder, is a plant species that belongs to the Polemoniaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to relax the respiratory muscles and reduce inflammation, while its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids and phenolic compounds, contribute to its medicinal properties.
